v11-12:1.question: When the trees ask the vine to be king, who would it rule?
v11-12:1.reason: Asks who the vine would rule. The text names the intended subjects but gives no motive for the invitation.

v26-29:1.question: Who had gained the citizens’ trust by the time they cursed Abimelek at the festival?
v26-29:1.reason: Connects the citizens’ trust to the festival where their opposition to Abimelek becomes explicit.
